title: •Kebyc
caption: •Kebyc (V)
game_text: Deploys free to Cloud City. You activate +1 Force for every Cloud City site you occupy. Your aliens are deploy -1 here. Opponent’s aliens are deploy +1 here.
lore: Senior accountant for the Cloud City Miner’s Guild. Administrates the annual dues and fights corruption among her fellow guild members.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 1 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 3 / forfeit 5. Icon column empty (only the set sphere). Alien (Cloud City frame, alien disc). Curly apostrophe in Opponent’s. Slip text matches the stub. Printed face = 'Kebyc (Original)' (the wiki's default page carries the same printed text; a PC Errata 2023 version exists). The 745 px CC-L-kebyc.gif is tagged D-E1 (PC Errata face: 'related cloud sectors') — downloaded to src/vs6/12-CC-L-kebyc.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Miner’s (wiki straight). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
